newsitem.title: USA: Swing-N-Slide to acquire Game Time.
newsitem.headline: Swing-N-Slide to acquire Game Time.

text.p: Swing-N-Slide Corp said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Game Time Inc in a deal valued at about $40.5 million.

Swing-N-Slide, a manufacturer of consumer do-it-yourself wooden playground equipment, said it will pay $27 million in cash and notes for the stock of Game Time, which provides commercial outdoor playground equipment. Swing-N-Slide said it values the total transaction at about $40.5 million, including Game Time's long-term debt.
The acquisition is expected to close by the end of the first quarter of 1997, the company said.

For the year ended December 31, 1996, Game Time had net sales of $48.9 million. Game Time is expected to account for about 40 percent of the operating cash flow of the combined companies, the company said.

Swing-N-Slide said the acquisition will reduce the seasonality of its overall business. The consumer Swing-N-Slide business typically generates 75 percent of sales in the first two quarters of the year, while Game Time has more than 60 percent of its sales during the second and third quarters of the year, the company said.

"The acquisition, which will more than double the size of Swing-N-Slide, creates a more diversified company, combines two industry leaders and provides significant operating and marketing synergy," said Richard Mueller, chairman and chief executive officer of Swing-N-Slide.
